steps.name: Handler's Breathing
steps.description: Stand tall, feet hip-width, corgi at heel. Inhale for four, exhale for six. The corgi will breathe faster than you. This is not a competition.

steps.name: Sniff Walk Activation
steps.description: Walk the room at an easy pace, changing direction every few steps. Your corgi decides the route. Accept this.

steps.name: Leash Pass-Through
steps.description: Hold the leash wide in both hands and pass it slowly over your head and behind you, then back. Widen the grip if the shoulders complain. A genuine mobility drill. No corgi required.

steps.name: Downward Dog, Supervised
steps.description: Hands and feet down, hips high, spine long. Your corgi will inspect the form at close range. Hold the position. The face-licking is part of the protocol.

steps.name: Hip Opener, 90/90
steps.description: Seated, both knees at 90 degrees, rocking the knees slowly side to side. The corgi may occupy the gap between your legs. Work around it.

steps.name: Corgi Curl
steps.description: Corgi held under the chest and front legs, back fully supported. Curl slowly to the chin, lower under control. Roughly twelve kilos of deeply unimpressed dumbbell. End the set the second the dog wants down.

steps.name: Corgi-Loaded Goblet Squat
steps.description: Hold the corgi close to the chest like a goblet, elbows tucked in. Squat slow, chest proud, heels planted. Keep the descent smooth. The load has strong opinions about being jostled.

steps.name: Reverse Lunge, Left Lead
steps.description: Corgi in the front-rack position against the chest. Step the left leg back, lower the knee, drive up. The free hand stays under the dog at all times.

steps.name: Reverse Lunge, Right Lead
steps.description: Same movement, stepping the right leg back. By now the load has usually fallen asleep. Do not wake it. Just keep lunging.

steps.name: Leash Rope Skipping
steps.description: Double the leash over and use it as a skipping rope, corgi unclipped and well clear of the swing. Small hops, quiet landings. The corgi will bark at the rope. That is the corgi's contribution.

steps.name: Overhead Corgi Press
steps.description: Only if the dog is genuinely happy up there. Press to just above the head, no lockout, both hands under the ribcage and hips. If the corgi objects, press a full laundry bag instead and tell nobody.

steps.name: Fetch Interval Sprint
steps.description: Throw, then sprint alongside the dog to the toy. The corgi will win. The corgi has always won. The point is the sprint.

steps.name: Corgi Farmer's Carry
steps.description: Corgi carried at the side or across the chest, shoulders down, ribs stacked, walking tall. Short legs, long torso, surprising density. Brace like you mean it.

steps.name: Loaded Glute Bridge
steps.description: On your back, feet planted, corgi resting across the hips. Lift until knee, hip and shoulder line up, squeeze for two seconds, lower slowly. Steady the passenger with both hands.

steps.name: Weighted Plank, Voluntary Loading
steps.description: Forearm plank. The corgi will board without being asked. Hold the line, do not sag, do not laugh. Laughing collapses the plank.

steps.name: Treat-Level Deadlift
steps.description: Treat jar on the floor. Hinge at the hips, flat back, drive through the heels to stand, lower it back down. Repeat. The corgi supervises from directly underfoot, which is the actual difficulty.

steps.name: Double Dog
steps.description: Two humans, one downward dog. Partner A holds a solid down dog. Partner B plants their hands on the floor ahead and rests their shins on A's lower back. Build up slowly, talk to each other, come down together. The corgi walks underneath and judges.

steps.name: Zoomie Intervals
steps.description: The corgi initiates. You match the pace. Hard effort, sharp turns, no dignity. Ends when the corgi decides it ends.

steps.name: Belly-Rub Russian Twist
steps.description: Seated, heels light on the floor, leaning back to a strong angle. Rotate side to side, one hand landing on the corgi belly each rep. Slow and controlled. The belly is the metronome.

steps.name: Sit. Stay.
steps.description: Deep squat or cross-legged sit, spine tall, hands resting on the knees. Hold. You are now doing exactly what the corgi has been doing all session.

steps.name: Bowl Reach
steps.description: Seated, legs long, fold forward from the hips with a long back, reaching as if for a distant food bowl. You will not reach it. Neither will the corgi.

steps.name: Supine Twist, Corgi Optional
steps.description: On your back, knees dropped to one side, head turned the other way. Switch halfway through. If a corgi installs itself on your ribcage, that is added resistance.

steps.name: Couch Stretch, Actual Couch
steps.description: Rear foot up on the couch, front foot forward, hips pushed gently through. Half the time per side. Undoes everything a desk chair has done to your hip flexors.

steps.name: Final Belly Rub
steps.description: Lie flat, eyes closed, one hand on the dog. Nothing left to lift. Long exhales. The corgi has been ready for this since minute one.
